_comment: Prior-year team name -> current MFL franchise name.
The keeper workbook is built from last season's rosters, so a team that
renamed or changed owner still carries its old label and cannot be matched
to a current franchise without this.
Maintained here OR as a 'TeamAliases' sheet in the workbook (two columns,
PriorYearTeam | CurrentYearTeam). The sheet wins where both define a name.
Clear this out when the workbook is rebuilt on current-season names.
